{{Top}}
'''Bacta spray''' was a form of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] used to heal minor wounds. They were the main component of [[Bacta patch/Legends|bacta patches]], and small vials of it were commonly found in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]. Bacta spray could be put on almost any ailment to keep the injury at bay until a proper [[Medic/Legends|medic]] could arrive.<ref name="hc">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>
